about_text:
Stream Deck Linux Configurator {version}
For Stream Deck XL 20GAT9901 · Ubuntu 24.04.
Edits drafts; the separate Controller owns USB and executes approved actions.
Plugins are deferred. Desktop UI: English/French. Technical Controller diagnostics retain their original language.
plugins_explanation: Plugins are not loaded or executed in this release. Existing plugin bindings, dynamic appearance settings, and extension fields are preserved. CPU, storage, and web-service integrations will be added later through the Controller extension boundary.
plugin_preserved: Plugin display attached. Edit its settings separately; normal previews remain static and never start it.
draft_only_hint: DRAFT WORKSPACE  ·  Editing, saving, and previewing do not change the physical deck. Use Review & apply when ready.
grid_hint: Click to edit. Double-click a section or Back to browse locally. Drag buttons to rearrange; drop an image to import. Grid clicks never run programs.
grid_zoom: Preview size; source images remain 96 × 96 pixels
button_copied: Button and its subsection tree copied.
back_reserved: Reserved Back button. It is generated by the Controller and cannot be edited, moved, or replaced.
preview_sizes: 96 × 96 source preview · enlarged preview. Display scaling may affect physical screen size.
button_text_hint: Button label; line breaks are preserved
navigation_action_hint: Move or delete this subsection first. Replacing a navigation action would orphan its child pages.
delete_subtree: Delete this navigation button and all {count} sections beneath it? This changes only the draft and can be undone.
delete_button_question: Clear this button from the draft? You can undo this change.
root_not_movable: The root section cannot be moved or duplicated as a child. Copy individual buttons instead.
literal_arguments_hint: No implicit shell. Each argument row is passed as one literal argument, including spaces and empty strings. Saving this action does not execute it.
environment_warning: Environment values are stored in plaintext in private draft/configuration files and included in exports. Do not use these fields as a secret store.
argv_preview: Literal argv preview — not a shell command
save_with_path_warning: Some paths are unavailable on this computer. Keep this action in the draft anyway?
settings_hint: These settings change only the draft until Apply. Leave the serial empty for automatic selection. Some unopened devices do not report a serial; use the Controller selection workflow if needed.
review_summary: Apply “{name}” over “{previous}”, currently revision {revision}? This replaces the active configuration, not just the selected button.
apply_not_execute: Apply enables this layout for future physical button presses. It does not execute the listed applications or scripts now.
review_acknowledgement: I reviewed the executable paths and arguments and approve these actions for future button presses.
replace_acknowledgement: I confirm replacing the active configuration with this draft.
revision_conflict: The Controller changed after this draft was loaded. Your draft was preserved. Continue to review an explicit replacement of the latest configuration? Cancel keeps your draft without changing the Controller.
pending_hint: An interrupted Apply has an unresolved outcome. Use Controller → Resolve interrupted Apply before applying another draft. Your draft is preserved.
no_pending: There is no interrupted Apply to resolve.
resolve_apply_question: Resolve using the original operation ID? The Controller returns a previously committed result without duplicating it. If a non-executable configuration was never committed, this explicit retry may commit it. Uncommitted executable actions require a fresh review.
discard_pending_question: Forget the local pending-Apply record? This does not undo a configuration already committed by the Controller. Load from Controller to inspect the actual active configuration.
apply_first: Apply this exact draft first. Browsing the editor never navigates the physical deck automatically.
applied_pending_display: Revision {revision} committed. Check device synchronization separately.
show_section: Show this applied section on deck
execute_warning: THIS WILL EXECUTE A PROGRAM NOW through the Controller. Review the applied action below. Continue?
execution_submitted: Execution request submitted. Inspect Recent executions for the result.
execution_unknown: Do not click Run again blindly. The request may already have executed. Inspect Recent executions; this application never retries execution automatically.
cancel_task_question: Cancel this managed task? Independent applications cannot be canceled here.
no_active_tasks: No cancellable managed task appears in these recent records. Reopen the history to refresh.
diagnostics_saved: Diagnostics exported. Review the file before sharing it.
validation_passed: The draft is valid. No validation warnings.
draft_differs: Draft is not the confirmed active configuration
controller_offline:
CONTROLLER UNAVAILABLE
Offline editing is available
offline_hint: Start the separate Controller with sdl-session --start. Offline drafts and previews remain available.
missing_images: {count} referenced image(s) are unavailable in the local cache. Reimport them or load from Controller. Apply/export requires every original.
ready: Ready · editing does not execute actions
draft_saved: Draft saved locally. The Controller was not changed.
imported_draft: Imported as a new, unapplied draft. Local execution approvals were not imported.
image_imported: Image converted and stored in the draft cache.
unsaved_question: Save a separate local copy before switching drafts? Cancel returns to the current draft.
close_recovery_question: Close with unsaved changes? A recovery draft will be kept and restored next time. Use Save draft to keep a named local snapshot.
close_busy_question: A Controller or file operation is in progress. Closing cancels the local request; an Apply might already have committed. Keep the recovery draft and close?
language_restart: Interface language saved. Close and reopen the Configurator to use it. User-entered button text is never translated.
export_privacy: The bundle includes program paths, arguments, images, and environment overrides. It excludes execution approvals and plugin secret references. Export this draft?
json_not_portable: JSON exported. It references managed image IDs but does not include the images. Use a portable bundle to transfer the complete configuration.
plugin_preserve_missing: Unavailable package — preserve the existing binding unchanged
plugin_offline_hint: Offline catalog. Editing changes only this draft; approvals are checked again by the Controller when applied.
plugin_edit_hint: This dialog never runs a plugin. Static icon/text remains the fallback; the button action is independent.
plugin_dynamic_enabled: Enable dynamic display on this button
plugin_limits_hint: At least one second between refreshes; CPU defaults to two seconds. Only the applied, visible device page collects data. Unchanged pixels are skipped. Many visible buttons share a bounded, fair display budget.
plugin_trust_hint: Only approve code you trust. Packages run as your user in limited processes, not a security sandbox. This screen shows cached runtime data and creates no hidden sampling demand. Rescan also refreshes diagnostics.
plugin_approval_warning: Approve this exact native package and interpreter? It may immediately start already-applied visible instances. Disclosed permissions are descriptive, not a security sandbox.
plugin_apply_notice: Applying does not execute button commands. Already-approved display plugins may collect data for the newly applied visible page.
